description: A half-circle arc with two series stacked end to end and the combined total beneath it.
overview: Uses `RadialBarChart` with `startAngle={180}`, `endAngle={0}`, `innerRadius="120%"`, `outerRadius="170%"` and `cy="86%"`, and two `RadialBar` elements (`desktop`, `mobile`) sharing `stackId="a"`, each with `cornerRadius={6}` and a 3-pixel `var(--surface-secondary)` stroke. `chartData` is a single `visitors` record `{ desktop, mobile }`; `chartConfig` colors `desktop` with `var(--blue)` and `mobile` with `var(--teal)`. A `PolarAngleAxis` with `domain={[0, total]}` makes the two segments fill the arc exactly. The overlay shows `total`.
usage: Replace `visitors` with your own fields and add a `RadialBar` with the same `stackId` and a `chartConfig` entry for each one; include every field in `total` so the arc stays full. Adjust `cy` and the radii together if you change the container height.
notes: The tooltip uses `hideLabel`. `accessibilityLayer` is set on `RadialBarChart`, so the chart is focusable from the keyboard.
